summary: First iteration testing of FocusLearn Expo mobile app. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (100%) covering health, profile, screen-time (daily/weekly/monthly), subjects, study-sets CRUD + filters, blocked-apps CRUD, full quiz flow (start with AI/fallback, answer, complete, points awarded 5/correct + 25 pass bonus), and rewards redemption (150 pts = 15 min with profile decrement). Frontend: Expo web preview loads, onboarding works, all 4 tabs navigable, home dashboard (points card, blocked apps, period toggle, simulate-lock, create-limit) render, marketplace shows 11 study sets with search/filter chips/FAB, practice screen lists 11 cards, profile shows redeem-150/300/600 buttons, quiz flow works end-to-end (5 AI-generated questions, 4 options each, submit/next navigation, correct-answer feedback), lock screen renders with start-challenge-button. AI quiz generation via GPT-5.2 is functional (observed custom-phrased questions).

issues: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — cosmetic only, should migrate to boxShadow and style.pointerEvents

react_native_issues.issue: Version 55.0.13 vs expected ~15.0.8 per Expo doctor. Works but may cause compat warning.
Version 15.15.4 vs expected 15.12.1. Works, just a version mismatch warning.

action_items: (Optional) Align expo-linear-gradient and react-native-svg versions with Expo doctor recommendations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan for future-proofing.
Quiz fallback generation uses shared random (module-level) — not an issue but could cause non-deterministic ordering; acceptable.
get_or_create_profile is called inside complete_quiz without $inc — uses read-modify-write; could race on concurrent quiz completions, but single-user local profile makes this acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testIDs verified; primary flows pass

seed_data_creation: Test created one study set 'TEST_Custom Set' (Biology, 2 cards, is_mine=true) via POST /api/study-sets as part of test_create_study_set. Earned ~150+ points during quiz flow tests; redeemed 150. These remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core backend + frontend flows are working. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_focuslearn_api.py is the regression suite. AI quiz generation takes ~8-10s, so use longer waits (10s) when testing quiz screen load via Playwright. No auth is used — local default profile.
rca_of_issue: No bugs requiring RCA. The initial Playwright attempt found 0 quiz options because the wait after tapping a practice card was only 3.5s; AI generation needs ~8-10s. Retest with 10s wait succeeded.
